Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25, triggered by church use at any future time, can vest outside lives in being plus 21 years, so the Rule Against Perpetuities voids it and the friend holds fee simple absolute.

Q8166.reason: Maine’s “hitherto” describes a historical tendency in progressive societies, and the aphorism is commonly misread as a prediction of future legal change.

Q5649.reason: Immediate post-operative care requires continuous urine-output monitoring, which is a standard contraindication to using a catheter valve.
